name: Osric's Crate
summary: Osric's Crate is a heavy package of freshly crafted armor dispatched from Stormwind to the struggling defenders of Sentinel Hill. Carried aboard a gryphon across the kingdom's flight network, it provides vital equipment to help the People's Militia hold Westfall against outlaw gangs.

sections.title: Supplies for the Front
sections.body: Westfall suffers under the predations of the Defias Brotherhood and marauding gnolls, while the Stormwind army remains absent. The local defenders, organized as the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill, lack the formal support of the crown and must rely on piecemeal supplies. Osric's Crate contains a fresh batch of protective armor sent from the capital to Quartermaster Lewis, intended to be parceled out directly to volunteer militia fighters on the ground.

sections.title: Winged Courier Network
sections.body: Transporting gear overland from Stormwind through Elwynn Forest and across the Westfall border is slow and fraught with bandit ambushes. To bypass the roads, the crate is entrusted to an adventurer flying via Dungar Longdrink's gryphon roost in Stormwind's Trade District down to Thor at Sentinel Hill. This swift delivery demonstrates the crucial role gryphons play in keeping frontier garrisons supplied during wartime.

faq.answer: The crate contains protective armor crafted in Stormwind. Quartermaster Lewis inspects its delivery and immediately prepares to distribute the armor among the fighters defending Sentinel Hill.
Osric is an armorer based in Stormwind who prepared this shipment of gear for the People's Militia holding Westfall.

aliases: who do i give osric's crate to
faq.answer: The shipment is addressed to Quartermaster Lewis, the officer managing supplies and equipment for the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

faq.q: Why is the crate delivered by gryphon?
faq.answer: Bandits and outlaws make the roads connecting Stormwind, Elwynn Forest, and Westfall perilous. Flying via gryphon from Dungar Longdrink in Stormwind directly to Thor at Sentinel Hill ensures the armor arrives quickly and safely.

angles.text: Every shipment of arms and armor that reaches Sentinel Hill helps keep the western borders of the kingdom from falling completely to the Defias Brotherhood.
